name: latent-b01
_notes: v5 first try: v4's best model (copied to runs/from-v4) plus a 32-dimensional per-tick latent (learned prior; the posterior sees the recorded next frame), fine-tuned on the CPU (the GPU was full with LM Studio's model). KL weight 0.1, 0.02 free nats per dimension. Aimed at v4's wind-down: a deterministic model averages the possible next frames into a calm one.
